cli.usage:
Usage:
  node cli.js prepare <spreadsheet.xlsx> <month> <year> [--lang=en|pt-BR|es]
      Reads the spreadsheet, matches it with Hourglass and creates reviews/review-YYYY-MM.xlsx. Sends nothing.

  node cli.js send <review-YYYY-MM.xlsx>
      Validates the review and shows what would be sent (simulation).

  node cli.js send <review-YYYY-MM.xlsx> --execute [--limit=N]
      Sends the rows with status SEND to Hourglass.

  node cli.js missing
      Lists who has not reported in the open month (creates reviews/missing-YYYY-MM.xlsx).

  node cli.js template
      Creates the template spreadsheet with an instructions sheet.

Session: session.json in this folder with {"hglogin": "...", "xsrf": "..."}.
Web interface: npm start (or start.bat).
